name: Blanche Aureus
source:
An apprentice of an unnamed guild within the domain of House Aspis, Blanche Aureus joined SOS Nu as its tech specialist.

On the Day of Infamy, Blanche was critically wounded and suffered severe burns during a fire bomb attack. The dying girl was resuscitated and reconstructed by a guild. Due to the lack of supplies in the emergency situation and a limited window to perform the surgery in the chaotic aftermath of the attack, Blanche's left arm is now plated with an unusual golden synthetic skin unlike the rest of her body. Awoken with a new and unfamiliar body, Blanche chose the name "White Gold" to signify her rebirth.

Little is known of Blanche's past before her reconstruction.

[spoiler]Even Blanche herself has no memory of her previous life. Acting in correspondence with her doctor, Blanche concocted a plan to retrieve her lost memories. The first step was to adopt what she believed to be the hairstyle of her mysterious past inspired by a recurring dream she has been witnessing.

Blanche insists on maintaining a deep connection with her past self, vowed to never dishonour her would-be wishes by attempting communication via abstract means, asking for permission before making big decisions.

Blanche's past self has seemingly resurfaced with Blanche none the wiser.[/spoiler]

[In-Game Description]
